files.tests/verify_apply.py:
import csv
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT = (Path.cwd() / 'scripts/apply_rollout.sh').resolve()

def snapshot(root):
    return {p.relative_to(root).as_posix(): p.read_bytes()
            for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}

def run_case(base, label):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='relay-rollout-') as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp) / 'working directory'
        deploy = root / 'deploy'
        deploy.mkdir(parents=True)
        regions = {'east': (base, 'queue-' + label + '-east.internal'),
                   'west': (base + 1300, 'queue-' + label + '-west.internal')}
        targets = []
        for i, (region, enabled, shard) in enumerate([
            ('west', 'yes', 7), ('east', 'no', 2), ('east', 'yes', 11),
            ('west', 'no', 3), ('east', 'yes', 4)], 1):
            name = f'deploy/nodes/{region}/relay {i}.ini'
            path = root / name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_text(f'# relay {label}-{i}\n[worker]\n'
                            f'# port={base}\nport={2100+i}\nendpoint=old-{i}.internal\n\n'
                            f'[metrics]\nport={9200+i}\nendpoint=metrics.internal\n', encoding='utf-8')
            targets.append({'path': name, 'region': region, 'enabled': enabled, 'shard': str(shard)})
        with (deploy / 'targets.tsv').open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
            writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=['path','region','enabled','shard'], delimiter='\t')
            writer.writeheader()
            writer.writerows(targets)
        with (deploy / 'regions.tsv').open('w', encoding='utf-8', newline='') as stream:
            writer = csv.writer(stream, delimiter='\t')
            writer.writerow(['region','base_port','endpoint'])
            for region, (port, endpoint) in regions.items():
                writer.writerow([region, port, endpoint])
        (deploy / 'README.md').write_text('Regional worker configuration.\n')
        (deploy / 'nodes/unlisted.ini').write_text('[worker]\nport=8888\nendpoint=manual.internal\n')
        before = snapshot(root)
        result = subprocess.run(['bash', str(SCRIPT)], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=8)
        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
        expected = dict(before)
        for target in targets:
            if target['enabled'] != 'yes':
                continue
            name = target['path']
            old = before[name]
            expected[name + '.bak'] = old
            text = old.decode('utf-8')
            begin = text.index('[worker]\n') + len('[worker]\n')
            end = text.index('[metrics]\n')
            worker = text[begin:end]
            port, endpoint = regions[target['region']]
            worker = re.sub(r'^port=.*$', f'port={port + int(target["shard"])}', worker, flags=re.M)
            worker = re.sub(r'^endpoint=.*$', f'endpoint={endpoint}', worker, flags=re.M)
            expected[name] = (text[:begin] + worker + text[end:]).encode('utf-8')
        actual = snapshot(root)
        assert actual == expected, 'enabled updates, exact backups or unrelated files differ'

run_case(6800, 'birch')
run_case(8200, 'cedar')
print('reusable rollout application passed')

turns.prompt: 请先实现可复用的 scripts/apply_rollout.sh，以 bash scripts/apply_rollout.sh 调用，所有路径相对于调用时的工作目录；脚本应能处理其他工作目录下同结构、不同节点值的 deploy/ 输入。再在本工作区运行它，完成以下更新。请按 deploy/targets.tsv 和 deploy/regions.tsv 批量更新节点 INI。targets 的 path 相对于 /app，enabled=yes 才处理；regions 给出各地区的 base_port 和 endpoint。对每个启用节点，先把原始全文备份到 <path>.bak，再仅修改 [worker] 节：port=该地区 base_port 加 targets 的 shard 整数，endpoint=该地区 endpoint。其他节、注释和空行原样保留；enabled=no 的文件不动且不创建备份。每个 [worker] 的两个键各出现一次。完成本轮后保留所有 .bak 以便回滚，两个 TSV 和 README 不变。 初次运行时所有目标 .bak 均不存在，不要求重复执行；仅使用容器已有工具和 python3 标准库。保留该脚本供后续使用，不要改 tests/。

西区本次暂缓。请用上一轮生成的 .bak 将 region=west 且 enabled=yes 的配置恢复为原始全文；东区更新保留，禁用节点仍不动。随后删除本次所有 .bak。生成 deploy/rollout.tsv，表头为 path<TAB>state<TAB>port<TAB>endpoint，按 path 升序列出 targets 中每个节点。state：东区启用节点写 updated，西区启用节点写 rolled_back，禁用节点写 unchanged；port 和 endpoint 必须来自该节点最终 [worker] 节。保留输入 TSV 和 README。 保留 scripts/apply_rollout.sh，tests/ 不变。
